material.acceptance_criteria: play.js hands the wasm source to the module itself so a normal boot fetches web_bg.wasm exactly once (probe shows 1 GET per load on a normal boot); page-smoke and first-draw still pass; no recoverGame/wasm-swap regression
material.description: Direct server-side probe across 3 play.html loads shows the wasm served multiple times per load (per-load totals are integer multiples of one gzip body: loads 2-3 of every load fetched it twice, load 1 made an extra request, one followed by a browser abort). loadSim() calls mod.default() with no args, so bindgen glue resolves and fetches the URL itself (streaming attempt + fallback), and checkWasmWatch() HEADs it every 2 s. Each redundant fetch costs ~0.5 MB gzip plus decompress+compile on the boot path.

material.subject: web_bg.wasm is fetched more than once per load (2-3 GETs + HEAD watcher); dedupe the boot path
material.witness_plan: Separate-session witness runs the multi-load probe against a stage built after the change and counts web_bg.wasm requests per load, then checks page-smoke

note: Method-level probe settled the premise: a normal boot GETs web_bg.wasm exactly once per load; the extra reads were checkWasmWatch() HEAD polls every 2 s, which the first-draw server answered as full gzip GET bodies and note() counted (CI per-load totals = 1 GET + HEADs at 2 s cadence, hence integer multiples; load-1 deltas from the first poll window). No play.js change and no lost bytes. Fix in scripts/perf/first-draw.mjs (2484ccb889969326ea8f5b29c554e7ddaa657c70): HEAD answers headers-only with etag/last-modified for the watcher signature; verified on the same artifact -- web_bg.wasm reads 481898 B on all 3 loads, requests 185 -> 178, median 3922 ms ok -- and AGENTS.md records the accounting rule.
